worker_claim.report: Local implementation and available target validation are finished. The packaging/standalone suite passed 143 tests before the final Git-minimum and removed-requirement cases; the final affected native-package suite passed 50 tests. Ruff, shell syntax, and git diff --check passed. readelf/ldd inspection covered the packaged launcher and extracted PBS interpreter and libraries; native provider ownership was checked using pacman and dpkg-query. Both updated native generators produced byte-identical repeated smoke packages using the exact standalone payload validated by a clean-tree build before edits. Final Arch and Debian 12 container checks passed metadata inspection, dependency resolution, installed Git-adapter/capability checks, no-host-Python execution, integrity, removal, and reinstallation. Arch additionally rejected installation while mandatory Git was absent. These smoke packages reused validated payload bytes through a local test harness; they are not claimed as final clean-tree release builds. ./dev package arch correctly refuses the edited worktree, and the worker contract prohibits committing or integrating the changes to satisfy that precondition. The real Arch dogfooding-host acceptance check cannot be performed from this workspace.
